base_verified: HEAD at lane start equaled base_sha (git rev-parse); merge-base(HEAD, base) == base
mechanism_class: volatility/liquidity state transitions visible in H1 OHLCV

mechanism_summaries.subclass: compression->expansion state transition (H1 range/vol estimator state)
mechanism_summaries.state_variable: 24-bar true-range sum vs median of 10 prior non-overlapping 24-bar blocks (realized-vol compression, median split)
mechanism_summaries.entry_logic: first-of-day H1 close beyond the 48-bar high/low channel while compressed -> continuation of the breach side at next H1 open; single exit at 16:00 America/New_York bar open on entry UTC day
mechanism_summaries.control: identical 48-bar breakout with the compression-state gate deleted (removes exactly the state-conditioning)
mechanism_summaries.neighbour: compression gauged by prior NY trading day's range vs its 10-day median (one presumption changed)

mechanism_summaries.state_variable: same-day Asian-window (UTC 00-06) high-low range vs trailing 15-day median (thinness) + first turnover burst (TR > 1.5x same-day Asian median TR, UTC 06-10 window)
mechanism_summaries.entry_logic: on first burst while thin -> reversion opposite the Asian-drift sign (00-06 UTC close minus open) at next H1 open; single exit at 16:00 America/New_York bar open on entry UTC day
mechanism_summaries.control: identical burst-reversion with the thin-state gate deleted (removes exactly the state-conditioning)
mechanism_summaries.neighbour: thinness gauged by Asian true-range sum instead of high-low range (one presumption changed)
mechanism_summaries.literature: Andersen & Bollerslev 1998 JF 53(1); Bollerslev & Domowitz 1993 JF 48(4)

arms_per_proposal: control (placebo deleting only the state gate; must NOT reproduce the mechanism)
design_discipline.state_conditional_not_clock_directional: no wall clock keys any trade direction in either proposal; the only NY reference is the universal forced-flat clock
design_discipline.forbidden_inventory_checked: London-open continuation, NY-open nearby-clock continuation, late-NY standardized-extension fade, London-to-NY momentum duplicate, sign inversion, session relabeling, threshold/lookback rescue, lower fees -- none applies; differentiation arguments are frozen inside each proposal and in search_log.md section 5

firewall_attestation.git_history: no git log / git show / git diff; only rev-parse, merge-base, branch --show-current, status for lane bookkeeping

outcome_blind_attestation.note: all frequency/sample figures are analytic schedule-level estimates; proposals are schedule-level designs only
